title: Commercial Loan Application
description: Commercial Loan Application contract normalized from the DocuBricks Financial services library.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Form
metadata:
  name: docubricks-fs-commercial-loan-application
  title: Commercial Loan Application
  description: Commercial Loan Application contract normalized from the DocuBricks Financial services library.
  version: fs_commercial_loan_application_v1
  source:
    system: docubricks
    sourceId: fs/commercial_loan_application
    sourcePath: Schemas/fs/commercial_loan_application
    sourceVersion: fs_commercial_loan_application_v1
    sourceDigest: 5efa966df140d3fff6fe136390fdb2a694d9e862df729d9f163873c115b1fbc6
spec:
  role: start
  pages:
    - id: main
      title: Commercial Loan Application
      sections:
        - id: dates-and-terms
          title: Dates And Terms
          description: Dates And Terms fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: application-date
              name: application_date
              label: Application Date
              description: Date the application was signed or submitted.
              dataType: date
              widget: date
            - id: requested-term-months
              name: requested_term_months
              label: Requested Term Months
              description: Requested maturity or amortization in months.
              dataType: integer
              widget: number
        - id: document-details
          title: Document Details
          description: Document Details fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: applicant-entity-type
              name: applicant_entity_type
              label: Applicant Entity Type
              description: Corporation, LLC, partnership, sole proprietorship, nonprofit, trust, or other.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: applicant-naics-code
              name: applicant_naics_code
              label: Applicant Naics Code
              description: NAICS code if present.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: applicant-industry
              name: applicant_industry
              label: Applicant Industry
              description: Industry or business description.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: contact-email
              name: contact_email
              label: Contact Email
              description: Email address.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: contact-phone
              name: contact_phone
              label: Contact Phone
              description: Phone number.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: years-in-business
              name: years_in_business
              label: Years In Business
              description: Years operating.
              dataType: number
              widget: number
            - id: annual-revenue
              name: annual_revenue
              label: Annual Revenue
              description: Annual gross revenue.
              dataType: number
              widget: number
            - id: requested-facility-type
              name: requested_facility_type
              label: Requested Facility Type
              description: Term loan, revolving line, equipment loan, CRE loan, SBA loan, construction loan, or other.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: existing-bank-relationship
              name: existing_bank_relationship
              label: Existing Bank Relationship
              description: Whether applicant states an existing relationship with the lender.
              dataType: boolean
              widget: checkbox
            - id: net-worth
              name: net_worth
              label: Net Worth
              description: Net worth if stated.
              dataType: number
              widget: number
            - id: signature-title
              name: signature_title
              label: Signature Title
              description: Signer title.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
        - id: financials
          title: Financials
          description: Financials fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: applicant-tax-id-masked
              name: applicant_tax_id_masked
              label: Applicant Tax Id Masked
              description: Masked EIN or tax identifier.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: requested-loan-amount
              name: requested_loan_amount
              label: Requested Loan Amount
              description: Requested credit amount.
              dataType: number
              widget: number
              required: true
            - id: loan-purpose
              name: loan_purpose
              label: Loan Purpose
              description: Stated use of proceeds.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: total-liabilities
              name: total_liabilities
              label: Total Liabilities
              description: Total business liabilities if stated.
              dataType: number
              widget: number
        - id: parties
          title: Parties
          description: Parties fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: applicant-legal-name
              name: applicant_legal_name
              label: Applicant Legal Name
              description: Legal name of the borrowing business.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
              required: true
            - id: applicant-dba-name
              name: applicant_dba_name
              label: Applicant Dba Name
              description: DBA or trade name.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: contact-name
              name: contact_name
              label: Contact Name
              description: Primary contact or authorized representative.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: guarantor-names
              name: guarantor_names
              label: Guarantor Names
              description: Individual or entity guarantors.
              dataType: array
              widget: textarea
              span: 2
            - id: relationship-manager-name
              name: relationship_manager_name
              label: Relationship Manager Name
              description: Banker or RM name.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: ownership-summary
              name: ownership_summary
              label: Ownership Summary
              description: Concise ownership description.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: beneficial-owner-count
              name: beneficial_owner_count
              label: Beneficial Owner Count
              description: Count of beneficial owners listed.
              dataType: integer
              widget: number
            - id: signature-name
              name: signature_name
              label: Signature Name
              description: Signer name.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
        - id: property-or-asset
          title: Property Or Asset
          description: Property Or Asset fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: applicant-address
              name: applicant_address
              label: Applicant Address
              description: Principal business address.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: collateral-description
              name: collateral_description
              label: Collateral Description
              description: Summary of proposed collateral.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: total-assets
              name: total_assets
              label: Total Assets
              description: Total business assets if stated.
              dataType: number
              widget: number
  validationRules:
    - id: applicant-legal-name-present
      severity: error
      description: A commercial loan application is not actionable without borrower legal identity.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: applicant_legal_name
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: applicant_legal_name
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: applicant_legal_name IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(applicant_legal_name)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: requested-loan-amount-positive
      severity: error
      description: Requested loan amount is required and must be positive.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: requested_loan_amount
          - op: gt
            left:
              field: requested_loan_amount
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: requested_loan_amount IS NOT NULL AND requested_loan_amount > 0
      supported: true
    - id: application-date-valid
      severity: warning
      description: Future application dates usually indicate extraction or data-entry errors.
      sourceExpression: application_date IS NULL OR application_date <= CURRENT_DATE()
      supported: false
      unsupportedReason: CURRENT_DATE() requires a runtime today operand.
    - id: entity-type-present
      severity: warning
      description: Entity type is important for KYB, authority, and beneficial ownership review.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: applicant_entity_type
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: applicant_entity_type
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: applicant_entity_type IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(applicant_entity_type)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: guarantors-array-valid
      severity: warning
      description: Guarantors should be represented as an array when present.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: guarantor_names
          - op: gte
            left:
              length: guarantor_names
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: guarantor_names IS NULL OR JSON_ARRAY_LENGTH(guarantor_names) >= 0
      supported: true
  reviewPolicy:
    unsupportedRuleAction: human-review
    defaultConfidenceThreshold: 0.75
    fieldConfidence:
      applicant_legal_name:
        minConfidence: 0.93
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: Borrower legal identity anchors KYB, credit file, and downstream loan records.
      applicant_tax_id_masked:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: Masked EIN supports borrower identity matching.
      requested_loan_amount:
        minConfidence: 0.94
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Requested amount drives underwriting and approval thresholds.
      requested_facility_type:
        minConfidence: 0.85
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Facility type routes the application to the right credit workflow.
      signature_name:
        minConfidence: 0.86
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Signer identity supports authorization review.
  modelRouting:
    primary: databricks-claude-sonnet
    fallbackChain:
      - databricks-meta-llama-3-70b-instruct
    maxTokens: 4096
    temperature: 0
    timeoutSeconds: 30
    maxRetries: 2
    tierOverrides: {}
    rationale: Commercial loan applications combine borrower, KYB, ownership, requested credit, collateral, and
      financial profile fields that benefit from strong long-context extraction.
  submissionSchema:
    type: object
    properties:
      application_date:
        type: date
        description: Date the application was signed or submitted.
        format: date
      applicant_legal_name:
        type: string
        description: Legal name of the borrowing business.
      applicant_dba_name:
        type: string
        description: DBA or trade name.
      applicant_tax_id_masked:
        type: string
        description: Masked EIN or tax identifier.
      applicant_entity_type:
        type: string
        description: Corporation, LLC, partnership, sole proprietorship, nonprofit, trust, or other.
      applicant_naics_code:
        type: string
        description: NAICS code if present.
      applicant_industry:
        type: string
        description: Industry or business description.
      applicant_address:
        type: string
        description: Principal business address.
      contact_name:
        type: string
        description: Primary contact or authorized representative.
      contact_email:
        type: string
        description: Email address.
      contact_phone:
        type: string
        description: Phone number.
      years_in_business:
        type: number
        description: Years operating.
      annual_revenue:
        type: number
        description: Annual gross revenue.
      requested_loan_amount:
        type: number
        description: Requested credit amount.
      requested_facility_type:
        type: string
        description: Term loan, revolving line, equipment loan, CRE loan, SBA loan, construction loan, or other.
      loan_purpose:
        type: string
        description: Stated use of proceeds.
      requested_term_months:
        type: integer
        description: Requested maturity or amortization in months.
      collateral_description:
        type: string
        description: Summary of proposed collateral.
      guarantor_names:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
        description: Individual or entity guarantors.
      existing_bank_relationship:
        type: boolean
        description: Whether applicant states an existing relationship with the lender.
      relationship_manager_name:
        type: string
        description: Banker or RM name.
      ownership_summary:
        type: string
        description: Concise ownership description.
      beneficial_owner_count:
        type: integer
        description: Count of beneficial owners listed.
      total_assets:
        type: number
        description: Total business assets if stated.
      total_liabilities:
        type: number
        description: Total business liabilities if stated.
      net_worth:
        type: number
        description: Net worth if stated.
      signature_name:
        type: string
        description: Signer name.
      signature_title:
        type: string
        description: Signer title.
    required:
      - applicant_legal_name
      - requested_loan_amount
    additionalProperties: false
    x-ladder-docubricks:
      completenessChecklist:
        - id: required_fields_present
          description: All required fields are present or explicitly null with low confidence when absent.
          fields:
            - applicant_legal_name
            - requested_loan_amount
        - id: section_coverage_reviewed
          description: Each declared section was reviewed for extractable evidence.
          sections:
            - dates_and_terms
            - document_details
            - financials
            - parties
            - property_or_asset
        - id: nested_lists_normalized
          description: Object array fields use their item_schema for consistent nested extraction.
          fields: []
